Class CommentTextArea.RoundBorder

java.lang.Object
javax.swing.border.AbstractBorder
ru.yanes.Panels.CommentTextArea.RoundBorder
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Border
Enclosing class:
CommentTextArea
class CommentTextArea.RoundBorder extends AbstractBorder
Inner class implementing a border with rounded corners. Draws a rounded rectangle outline using the specified width, radius, and color. Returns the appropriate padding to prevent text from overlapping the border.

      public void paintBorder(Component c, Graphics g, int x, int y, int width, int height)

    • getBorderInsets

      public Insets getBorderInsets(Component c)
      Returns the padding the component must have to prevent its contents from intersecting with the rounded border. The padding is equal to the corner radius on all sides.
      Specified by:
      getBorderInsets in interface Border
      Overrides:
      getBorderInsets in class AbstractBorder
      Parameters:
      c - the component for which the padding is calculated.
      Returns:
      an Insets object with equal padding equal to cornerRadius.
